name: trmnl-agent-bridge
description: Publish compact local agent status updates to TRMNL through the trmnl-agent CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Send safe Codex status snapshots to TRMNL.
interface.longDescription: Use TRMNL Agent Bridge to summarize the current Codex run into a compact, privacy-safe agent-status payload, dry-run it locally, push it to a TRMNL Private Plugin webhook, and run setup or smoke-test checks through the trmnl-agent CLI.
defaultPrompt: Publish the current Codex status to TRMNL.
Run the TRMNL bridge smoke test.
